# Pettifer

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

He is a low, stout, heavy-set man who is completely bald except for a small band of hair around his ears. He has a round, red face and prominent, bulging blue eyes.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c1 P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 c3 P42](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0042)_

## Personality

He is a short-tempered, candid, and eccentric man who speaks his mind freely and often gets flustered or angry. Despite his crusty and sharp exterior, he is essentially good-natured, hospitably offering tea and food to guests, and developing a soft spot for Nell's lively company. He is extremely touchy about his baldness and dislikes being nagged or interfered with, particularly by meddlesome neighbors.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P8](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0008), [v2 c1 P22](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0022), [v2 c3 P3](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0003), [v2 c3 P9](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0009), [v2 c3 P19](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0019), [v2 c3 P22](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0022), [v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 c3 P28](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0028), [v2 c3 P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049)_

## Traits

- Short-tempered  <sub>[v2 c1 P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 c3 P3](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0003), [v2 c3 P22](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0022)</sub>
- Candid and outspoken  <sub>[v2 c1 P8](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0008), [v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025)</sub>
- Eccentric  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- Sensitive about his baldness  <sub>[v2 c1 P22](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0022)</sub>
- Frugal  <sub>[v2 c1 P8](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0008)</sub>
- Fond of company despite a solitary lifestyle  <sub>[v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049)</sub>

## Abilities

- Farming and harvesting oats  <sub>[v2 c1 P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 c2 P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 c3 P9](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0009)</sub>
- Brewing good tea  <sub>[v2 c3 P34](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0034)</sub>
- Agile enough to leap over fences  <sub>[v2 c1 P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003)</sub>

## Goals

- To protect his oat crops and property from trespassing animals  <sub>[v2 c1 P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 c1 P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015)</sub>
- To live quietly without interference from meddling neighbors or wives  <sub>[v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c1 P8](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0008), [v2 c3 P1](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0001)</sub>

## History

After moving to Brierley, Pettifer gained a reputation among locals as an eccentric bachelor who kept a messy house, hired a young farmhand named John Henry Carter, and owned a foul-mouthed parrot named Nutmeg. In August, he flew into a rage when Nell's Jersey cow repeatedly trespassed into his oatfield and confronted Nell, making rude remarks about her red hair before being insulted about his own baldness in return. Soon after, Nell accidentally sold Pettifer's Jersey cow to a cattle buyer, mistaking it for her own. Upon realizing her mistake, Nell visited Pettifer's house to confess and apologize, bringing a nut cake as a peace offering. Pettifer accepted her apology good-naturedly, traded for Nell's cow instead, and invited her to stay for tea. Following this, the two became unlikely friends. Shortly afterward, his estranged wife, Emily, unexpectedly arrived at his home after reading a newspaper rumor about his impending marriage, and the two reconciled. Following Emily's return, Pettifer's house was thoroughly cleaned, and he settled happily back into married life.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c1 P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 c1 P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 c1 P21](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0021), [v2 c1 P22](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0022), [v2 c2 P22](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0022), [v2 c2 P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035), [v2 c3 P1](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0001), [v2 c3 P16](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0016), [v2 c3 P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 c3 P34](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0034), [v2 c3 P46](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0046), [v2 c3 P48](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0048)_

## Background by volume

- Formerly lived in Scottsford, New Brunswick, where his household was managed by his sister until her death
- Married Emily Scott, a former schoolteacher, who left him after a dispute over his foul-mouthed parrot
- Moved to St. Brendan's Island and bought the former Robert Bell farm next to Grey Shutters  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- Gifted a foul-mouthed parrot named Nutmeg by his brother, a seafaring man  <sub>[v2 c1 P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 c3 P2](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0002)</sub>

## Quotes

> There is nothing wrong with my fence. A demonic cow of that sort could not be contained even by the prison fence.  <sub>[v2 c1 P19](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0019)</sub>

> Furthermore, you ginger-haired slip of a thing, if that cow belongs to you, as you claim, your time would be far better spent keeping her away from the grain of others instead of lounging about reading yellow-backed books  <sub>[v2 c1 P19](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0019)</sub>

> I am not . . . not in the least. What is inside that box?  <sub>[v2 c3 P27](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0027)</sub>

> Listen to my suggestion, young lady, you need to assist me in consuming it. After I set the kettle to boil, a cup of tea will be enjoyed by both of us. Is that acceptable to you?  <sub>[v2 c3 P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031)</sub>

> I’m a crabbed, lonesome, crusty old chap, but I feel young again because of something about that little girl . . . and having that sensation repeated once in a while is something I’d like, since it’s so pleasant.  <sub>[v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049)</sub>
